t: Holmes 10th Anniversary Special: Behind The Overalls
d: Get a heartfelt look back at 10 years in the life of Canada's construction guru.

Learning how a home inspection dampened Kim and Daniel's plan to buy a cozy house where their two girls could grow up; Mike takes a thorough look and finds the source of all this humidity, then creates a dry, safe haven for the family.
When the pipes in the laundry room froze and the drain backed up, Mike and Tricia call Mike Holmes.

A rotten roof discovered accidentally by a satellite dish installer; Mike ponders ways to stretch Keith and Caitlin's repair budget as the team work to fill the gaps left in their previous inspection report.
Todd and Duane, excited about buying their first house together, tackle their home inspector's suggestions with enthusiasm until then they discover something that could ruin everything.

Mike and crew make an emergency house call to Fred and Sara's diminutive, historical two-storey; gaping holes in their seemingly solid home inspection have led to a high-stakes repair mission for Damon and the construction team.

Returning to Fred and Sara's petite historical home, where inspection misses have launched a rescue mission; Damon and the crew are tested by leaks, mold, foundation holes, dangerous fireplaces, shocking electrical and a plumbing disaster.
A widow needs help completing the DIY projects her "Good Samaritan" husband had started around the house before he passed away.

A single homeowner struggles with maintenance issues and repairs; when neighbors start complaining about the state of her home's exterior, Next Generation steps in to help her improve her home's curb appeal and get rid of the abandoned backyard pool.

A couple needs help updating their kitchen before putting their house on the market; after a local contractor lets them down and squanders their budget, Mike and the team swoop in to make things right and give this family a fresh start.

Mike Holmes and his children tackle a renovation that has fallen off the tracks for expectant parents; the team is on a time-sensitive mission to finish the nursery and the only working bathroom in the house prior to the baby's arrival.

John and Tanya purchase a 171-year-old home after a contractor guarantees it has been totally updated; John and Tanya encounter one problem after another, and they worry someone is going to fall through their spongy and sinking family-room floor.

A marathon dreams of designing the perfect kitchen; she hires a contractor who is unqualified for the job and winds up compromising her home's structure; now, it's up to Mike and his children to make things right and restore her peace of mind.
